notes.title: Game Release
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623584/3b19b04da50d8274d042812236950966e0c68021.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44623584/04f2b653ff18824e1a399669dd492f202b07f302.png[/img][/url]

Games for Stream! is the ultimate interactive experience for streamers and their audiences, bringing a new level of engagement to live content. Viewers can directly influence the game in real-time through chat messages, subscriptions, donations, and other platform events—helping or hindering the streamer in unexpected ways. Whether rewarding loyal fans with VIP status or playfully timing them out, streamers can create dynamic, unpredictable gameplay that keeps their community engaged and entertained. With endless ways to collaborate and compete, Games for Stream! turns every stream into an unforgettable, community-driven event. Get ready to blur the lines between player and audience—streaming will never be the same!

notes.title: TIKTOK INTEGRATION
notes.notes:
EDIT: Current issues with TikTok API. If you are a TikTok streamer please do not purchase while figuring this game out.

Hello everyone! Thank you so much for all of your feedback. In this latest update the game has integrated with TikTok events. If someone joins, types, or likes your stream they will be entered into your games! All you need to do is enter in your TikTok id and make sure you are live on Tiktok to start playing with your viewers! Given that this is still in early access, please expect some bugs here and there. We appreciate everyone for helping test these features. Thank you so much for all of your support, it is truly appreciated. Now let's play some games!!
